recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以中型原始細胞為主，染色質細緻、胞質少且無顆粒，部分核形不規則，並可見一個有絲分裂像與壓碎的細胞；殘存少數中性球與有核紅血球，符合急性淋巴母細胞白血病（T 細胞系需流式確認）。
features: Predominance of medium-sized blasts with round to irregular nuclei
Fine chromatin with small nucleoli in some cells
Scant to moderate pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Mitotic figure present; several crushed/smudged cells
Residual segmented neutrophil and dense erythroid precursors
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is composed predominantly of medium-sized blasts with round to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and scant agranular cytoplasm. A mitotic figure and several crushed cells are present, reflecting a proliferative, fragile population. Residual neutrophils and erythroid precursors are few. No Auer rods are identified. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; T-lymphoblastic lineage requires immunophenotypic confirmation.

ddx.vs: Distinguished only by immunophenotype (B-lineage markers instead of cytoplasmic CD3).
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and are surface Ig positive and TdT negative.
Myeloblasts show more cytoplasm, possible granules or Auer rods and MPO positivity.
